remarks: Take advantage of this fantastic opportunity to build your dream home in the “Back Nine at the Brook” development. The development overlooks beautiful Moon Brook Country Club. Moon Brook is a Robert Trent designed 18-hole golf course with lovely a club house, swimming pool and amenities. Lots #1,2,3 are wooded lots with a beautiful view of #12 fairway. The gas and electric are underground. The location is close to Jamestown, I-86 with Chautauqua Lake, Chautauqua Institution, Seneca Allegany Casino, Holiday Valley Resort nearby. This building lot is suitable for a single-family home or duplex! See attachments for map of development with lot numbers and building restrictions.
